caption:
How to turn customer reviews into marketing lines and improvement ideas with AI

Your reviews already contain your best copy and your clearest to-do list. One prompt pulls both out.

Copy this:

"Here are [NUMBER] customer reviews. 1) Write 5 short marketing lines using my customers' own words. Don't invent claims. 2) Find the 3 most repeated complaints, how many reviews mention each, and one practical fix for each. Reviews: [PASTE REVIEWS, NO NAMES]"

I tested it on 20 invented reviews for a pizza place. It found lines like "Gluten-free that doesn't taste like cardboard" and counted slow weekend delivery as the top complaint (3 of 20).

Two rules: remove names before pasting, and check that every marketing line matches something a customer really said.

Follow @nomorebusywork and comment PROMPTS: I'll DM you the free 25-prompt pack, with more prompts for reviews.
